Media & description guide

Five polished ways to describe Today’s Daily Battle, each written for a different place: headline, about box, directory listing, fuller write-up, and founder-voice story.

Open the site About Story

Ready-to-use versions

1 sentence pitch 
Today's Daily Battle is a calm, ad-free KJV Bible web app that helps people meet God in real battles through a daily verse, quiet search, battle plans, prayer, and offline-first privacy.
Short blurb 
Today's Daily Battle is a calm, privacy-respecting KJV Bible companion for anxiety, grief, fear, parenting strain, and ordinary hard days. It offers a daily verse, topic search, battle plans, prayer, memorization tools, and family resources without ads, noise, or pressure. Most features work without an account, and verses, notes, prayers, and progress stay on your device unless you choose to sync across devices.
Directory / press blurb 
Today's Daily Battle is a thoughtful Christian web app built around the King James Version Bible and designed to feel like a quiet place for real battles. Instead of ads, aggressive signups, or gamified pressure, it offers a daily verse, feeling-based Scripture search, short battle plans, prayer, memorization tools, family resources, and a full Bible reader in a calm, mobile-first experience. Most core features work entirely in the browser, so verses, notes, prayers, and progress stay private on your device unless you opt in to sync. Built solo by Brandon after a life-changing hospital season, the site stands out for its offline-first design, privacy-first posture, and humble, Scripture-first tone.
Full description 
Today's Daily Battle (todaysdailybattle.com) is a calm, ad-free Christian web app centered on the King James Version Bible. It is built for real battles: anxiety, grief, fear, anger, parenting strain, exhaustion, loneliness, and the ordinary days when someone simply needs strength and hope. The experience is intentionally quiet and user-paced. There are no ads, no competitive streak culture, and no pressure to create an account just to receive help. Instead, the site opens with a daily verse, gentle search by feeling or topic, short battle plans, prayer tools, memorization help, family resources, and a full KJV reader designed to work well on phones and keep functioning offline after first use. Most data stays on the user's device through local storage, so verses, notes, prayers, and progress remain private unless the user chooses to sign in for sync. Built solo by Brandon from a personal hospital-season need, Today's Daily Battle is a rare mix of practical Scripture help, privacy-first design, and human-scale honesty.
Founder voice 
I built Today's Daily Battle because I needed a quiet place in Scripture when life was loud. A hospital season made that plain to me. I did not need more hype, more scrolling, or more generic advice. I needed the Word of God near, clear, and steady. So I built what I still use every day: a calm KJV place for real battles. One verse. One prayer. One next step. No ads, no pressure, and no pretending people are okay when they are not. If the site feels simple, that is deliberate. I want people to find help here without feeling watched, crowded, or sold to.

Best-use notes

  • Use the 1 sentence pitch for app cards, intros, and quick replies.
  • Use the short blurb for about sections, footer notes, and short platform listings.
  • Use the directory / press blurb for newsletters, Christian directories, partner blurbs, or media mentions.
  • Use the full description when someone wants the whole shape of the product in one place.
  • Use the founder voice when you want the tone to sound personal instead of institutional.
